test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Take the wheels.

options.text: Let the wheels be taken by you.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Let the wheels be taken by you.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• To convert an active sentence to passive, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence, and the verb is changed to a passive form (usually "be" + past participle).
 
• **In this case, "wheels" is the object of the active sentence "Take the wheels." Therefore, it becomes the subject of the passive sentence.**
 
• **"Be taken" is the passive form of "take."**
 
• "By you" is added to indicate who is doing the action (in this case, taking the wheels).
 
• Thus, the given sentence in passive form will be:
 
 
• Let the wheels be taken by you.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Let the wheels take you," is in active voice and does not match the given sentence in passive voice.
 
• Option 2, "Let you take the wheels," is in active voice and has the subject and object reversed from the original sentence.
 
• Option 4, "Let wheels you take," is not grammatically correct.
